instruction.text: Choose which idiom can be used here.

atoms.a: You definitely need to prepare yourself.
At one point, we will all die. So try to enjoy your life as much as you can.
atoms.b: At one point, we will all ((++kick_the_bucket beat_around_the_bush)). So try to enjoy your life as much as you can.

atoms.a: Please keep me posted. That way I know what you're working on.
atoms.b: Please keep me ((++in_the_loop with_a_grain_of_salt)). That way I know what you're working on.

atoms.a: The unexpected weather change on our picnic date turned out to be a good thing, since we discovered a romantic restaurant nearby.
atoms.b: The unexpected weather change on our picnic date turned out to be a ((++blessing_in_disguise rain_check)), since we discovered a romantic restaurant nearby.

atoms.a: Uncle Jonathan always tends to exaggerate, so don't take his advice too seriously.
atoms.b: Uncle Jonathan always tends to exaggerate, so take his advice ((++with_a_grain_of_salt kick_the_bucket)).

atoms.a: It's easier for me, if you avoid bringing up things totally off-topic. So just be direct and say what you mean.
atoms.b: It's easier for me, if you avoid ((++beating_around_the_bush throwing_me_under_the_bus)). So just be direct and say what you mean.

atoms.a: By skipping essential steps in the process, they failed to follow safety instructions.
atoms.b: By ((++cutting_corners bringing_something_to_the_table)) in the process, they failed to follow safety instructions.
